title: プロジェクトデザインⅡ
subtitle: Design Project II
courseType: Design Project ProgramDesign Project CoursesDesign Project
educationalGoal:
You will be able to gain experience, knowledge, and skills to: Perform activities
based on logical thinking; Perform activities to solve an open-ended problem; Gather and utilize individual knowledge to solve problems; and Explore and creatively discover new problems.
advice:
- Project teams will work to gather new and previously gained knowledge, information, and experience towards solving real world problems of others.

- The Main Theme will be presented by the instructor in class.

- Through the project design activities, students are expected to be able to perform ‘activities based on logical thinking’, and their activities focus on: (a) Understanding required resources (information and experience), and making and evaluating decisions made logically based on data, facts, and truth; (b) Realizing characteristics of problems involved in human activities and needs of accumulating learning experiences of different fields of study; (c) Realizing the importance of finding Project Themes in a suited area defined by abilities; (d) Paying attention on problems and situations existing in the real world; (e) Ways to proceed activities (works) in a team (organization), and ways to find roles as a team member as simulation of OJT; (f) Ways to interact with others of different social positions; and (g) Realizing individual abilities by using basic knowledge through problem-solving process.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and experience learned and gained prior to the beginning of the course.

activityGoals.body: To be able to make and evaluate the decision made logically based on data, facts, and truth.
To be able to understand and gain resources (information and experience, etc.) required for project activities.
To be able to find a Project Theme appropriate for needs, abilities, and compensations from the Main Theme.
To be able to realize existing problems and develop awareness of problem-finding in the real world.
To be able to proceed effective project activities efficiently as a team (organization).
To be able to self-evaluate abilities objectively.
